description: This file defines the OpportunitiesParseRule class, which extends BaseRule and modifies panel data during pre-parsing for the Opportunities view in SuiteCRM. It primarily renames 'type' columns to 'opportunity_type' in the DetailView.

classes.name: OpportunitiesParseRule
classes.description: A custom parsing rule class for the Opportunities module that modifies panel data during pre-processing, specifically renaming certain fields for the DetailView.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the OpportunitiesParseRule class; currently empty.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Pre-processes panels data before rendering. If the view is 'DetailView', it searches for columns named 'type' and renames them to 'opportunity_type'.
